title: Qt: Add hover/pressed feedback to recent-filters arrow
description:
The recent-filters drop-down arrow used a single-token ThemedIcon, so its
hover and pressed states rendered the same colour as rest, giving no visual
feedback. Add a FilterHistory token (dimmed at rest, defaults to palette.mid)
and recolour the glyph to the brand colour on hover/press via the stateful
ThemedIcon. The default theme pins the classic Tango combo-arrow grays
(#555753 / #d3d7cf) so the resting look is unchanged.

Closes #21322
